name: Constanța

queries.query: Constanta Romania official cadastral parcel map GIS ANCPI Constanța cadastru hartă parcele
queries.result: First-party results identified OCPI Constanța, the official ANCPI public property viewer, the ANCPI INSPIRE Cadastral Parcel layer, and Constanța cadastral-sector materials. No live anonymous parcel feature response was obtained.

queries.query: Constanța cadastru hartă cadastrală parcele oficial ANCPI OCPI Constanța
queries.result: First-party results identified the official OCPI Constanța site, its PNCCF cadastral-sector/UAT map pages, RENNS information, and ANCPI's public property viewer. The indexed ANCPI layer metadata describes a polygon Cadastral Parcel layer, but current direct access failed.

registryBasis: OCPI Constanța is the official county cadastral and real-estate-publicity office. Its first-party site exposes PNCCF cadastral-sector/UAT map materials and links to the ANCPI Geoportal; this is local registry-custodian evidence, not only national-agency prose.

officialSources.observation: Official county office site with cadastral-sector/UAT map links and Geoportal links.
Official Constanța PNCCF page describing cadastral-program visualization and map materials.

Official public property-visualization application; indexed description says property boundaries can be consulted by address, county/UAT/cadastre-book number, or geographic position, subject to its terms.
Indexed first-party layer metadata identifies Cadastral Parcel, polygon geometry, EPSG:4258, JSON/GeoJSON support, and id_namespace as display field.
